problem_record.problem_statement: A fast, privacy-first, client-side SVG to WebP image converter with zero server uploads, live visual preview, adjustable WebP compression quality, dimension scaling, and instant local download.

target_user.primary_persona: Privacy-conscious professional / enterprise designer / security engineer
target_user.context_of_use: Fast-paced daily workflow requiring instant, friction-free outcomes

pain_points: Existing cloud-based tools force users to upload confidential data to untrusted remote servers.
Data privacy regulations (GDPR/HIPAA/internal infosec) strictly prohibit server-side file transmission.
Existing alternatives suffer from high latency, round-trip network delays, and sluggish UI response.
Legacy conversion tools enforce arbitrary file size caps, aggressive watermarking, or predatory paywalls.
Multi-step upload and download workflows interrupt productive developer and designer flow.

urgency_evaluation.status_quo_failure: Existing workarounds either violate security compliance or waste significant manual time.

problem_record.root_cause_analysis: Legacy tools monetize user data or rely on costly server compute, forcing an architectural mismatch between user privacy/speed needs and vendor profit models.
constraints: Strict Client-Side Boundary: All processing must occur 100% in-browser via WebAssembly, Web Workers, or Canvas APIs with zero server transmission.
Zero unnecessary dependencies: Keep client bundle lean and runtime responsive.
Mobile-first responsive architecture: Must function seamlessly on all viewport sizes.
Accessibility: Semantic HTML5 with WCAG 2.1 AA keyboard navigation.
desired_outcomes_and_success_criteria: Immediate task completion within 3 clicks or drag-and-drop actions.
100% verified zero outbound network requests for user file payloads.
Lighthouse performance score >= 90 across Mobile and Desktop.

market_sizing_estimate.addressable_audience: Global web users, developers, creators, and enterprise remote workers
market_sizing_estimate.growth_driver: Increasing data sovereignty regulations and demand for lightweight edge/browser utilities

competitor_matrix.key_strengths: High SEO visibility, established domain authority
competitor_matrix.critical_weaknesses: Server-side file uploads, heavy advertising clutter, intrusive trackers, slow page load, privacy risks
Expensive licensing, heavy install footprint, poor cross-device portability

market_gaps: Absence of transparent, clean, privacy-first browser tools without predatory paywalls.
Poor mobile responsiveness and ad-cluttered interfaces in existing status-quo utilities.
market_feasibility.value_proposition: Zero-Server In-Browser Execution: Instant, 100% private processing with zero file uploads and zero cloud latency.

monetization_and_distribution.primary_model: Open-source core with micro-SaaS enterprise tier

hurdle_rate_evaluation.gross_margin_potential: 90%+ (Client-side execution eliminates expensive backend compute costs)

prd_specification.core_thesis: Zero-Server In-Browser Execution: Instant, 100% private processing with zero file uploads and zero cloud latency.
prd_specification.target_persona: Privacy-conscious professional / enterprise designer / security engineer

mvp_scope.name: Intuitive Drag-and-Drop Ingestion Zone
mvp_scope.description: Accessible, interactive dropzone supporting file selection, paste from clipboard, and mobile file picker.
mvp_scope.acceptance_criteria: Files load into memory within 100ms with visual feedback and MIME-type validation.

mvp_scope.name: Core In-Browser Processing Pipeline
mvp_scope.description: Direct transformation engine executed locally via browser APIs (Canvas, WASM, Web Workers).
mvp_scope.acceptance_criteria: Transformation completes without freezing main thread; zero outbound network requests emitted.

mvp_scope.name: Instant Result Preview & 1-Click Export
mvp_scope.description: Side-by-side or immediate before/after preview with instant download action.
mvp_scope.acceptance_criteria: Download triggers immediately with sanitized filename; file size and format verified.

mvp_scope.name: Responsive Shell & Privacy Guarantee Badge
mvp_scope.description: Tailwind v4 styled layout displaying verified privacy badge and zero-server guarantee.
mvp_scope.acceptance_criteria: Fully responsive on viewports from 360px to 4K; 100% keyboard navigable.

negative_scope_exclusions.rationale: Unnecessary barrier for utility tools; increases friction and introduces user database liability.
Violates the strict privacy guarantee; adds recurring database/storage costs.
Premature optimization for MVP; slows initial delivery without proven demand.

negative_scope_exclusions.feature_name: Heavy Client-Side Frameworks with Hydration Overhead
negative_scope_exclusions.rationale: Astro static defaults provide zero-hydration performance and faster First Contentful Paint (FCP).
